title: Vasukie Divided Fridge Storage Boxes With 4 Serving Veggie Tray with Lid and Handle, Fridge Organizer with Removable 4 Compartment, Fridge Storage Containers (4 Compartment-1PC) Plastic, Clear
bullets: Saying Goodbye to Clutter, Food Stays Fresh Locked : Vasukie Fruit and vegetable storage containers allow you to stack and store food effortlessly, reducing clutter and keeping your refrigerator organized. Ideal for fruits, vegetables, candies, snacks, seasonings, dried fruits, and more, allowing you to mix and match as you please.

Selected Materials : Made from high-quality, food-grade PET materials, our containers are safe for direct contact with food, giving you peace of mind. The transparent design allows you to appreciate the aesthetics of your food storage while making it easy to see the contents. Perfect for family gatherings, parties, and picnics, these containers can also be used as stylish serving trays.

Drainage Holes and Handle Design : Equipped with drainage holes at the bottom of the four inner baskets, these containers make cleaning fruits and vegetables a breeze by preventing water accumulation and extending food shelf life. The inner baskets and outer box can be used separately, and the top handles ensure easy lifting and moving.

Upgraded Seal Ring : Featuring a silicone ring and four secure buckles, our fruit tray locks in freshness from all sides. The double-layer seal design prevents food odors from escaping and air from entering, ensuring your food stays fresh longer.

Easy to Clean : The detachable fruit storage container can be easily rinsed with water after use. There’s no need for dishwasher cleaning, which may cause slight deformation of the draining basket due to high temperatures. Note: Not suitable for dishwasher or microwave use.

Refrigeration and Freezing : Designed to withstand temperatures from -4°F to 140°F (-20°C to 62°C), our vegetable tray is perfect for both refrigeration and freezing. It helps you store and organize vegetables and fruits in the refrigerator, allowing you to enjoy fresh produce anytime.
